The Kids Clog

Inspired by our best-selling Clog, The Kids Clog features a roomy toebox and an adjustable hook and loop strap for the perfect fit. This style runs small, so we suggest ordering the next size up for a better fit. The soft flexible rounded upper is crafted in a warm brown with a star burst pattern, and the comfortable contoured footbed feels good on their soles. Durable rubber outsoles in tan add traction for everyday play, while the machine washable construction makes cleanup simple. Toss the shoes in the wash with cold water, then air dry and wear them again and again. This style is knit from recycled plastic bottles and is designed to keep little feet comfortable all day long.
